I have been growing rice here in Mwanza for many years, and I know this 0.85-hectare plot well. I will use improved seed because it gives better yields, and I will apply both manure and some chemical fertilizer to keep the soil fertile, though I cannot afford very much. I will also hire some laborers to help with transplanting and harvesting because my family cannot manage all the work alone on this plot. I do not have irrigation equipment, so I depend on the rains and the natural moisture from the nearby valley.
